offerTitle.description: Title of the card that offers the onboarding tour on first launch.

offerBody.message: Take a one-minute tour of the window?
offerBody.description: Body of the card that offers the onboarding tour on first launch.

start.description: Button that starts the onboarding tour.

notNow.description: Button that declines the onboarding tour. It won't be offered again, but stays in the Help menu.

label.description: Accessible name of the onboarding tour's step card.

stepCount.description: Progress caption on a tour step, such as "2 of 6". {{current}} is the number of this step, {{total}} the number of steps.

skipTour.description: Button on a tour step that ends the tour.

back.description: Button on a tour step that goes to the previous step.

next.description: Button on a tour step that goes to the next step.

done.description: Button on the last tour step that ends the tour.

editorTitle.description: Tour step title, pointing at the code editor.

editorBody.message: Each file of your Electron app has its own tab. Your changes are kept as you type.
editorBody.description: Tour step body, pointing at the code editor.

versionTitle.description: Tour step title, pointing at the version picker in the title bar.

versionBody.message: Pick any release. Electron Fiddle downloads it the first time you run it.
versionBody.description: Tour step body, pointing at the version picker in the title bar.

runTitle.description: Tour step title, pointing at the Run button.

runBody.message: Starts Electron with your code. Press it again to stop.
runBody.description: Tour step body, pointing at the Run button.

publishTitle.description: Tour step title, pointing at the Publish button.

publishBody.message: Publish it as a GitHub gist, and anyone can open it in Electron Fiddle.
publishBody.description: Tour step body, pointing at the Publish button.

consoleTitle.description: Tour step title, pointing at the console below the editor.

consoleBody.message: Logs from the main process and every renderer show up here.
consoleBody.description: Tour step body, pointing at the console below the editor.

sidebarTitle.description: Tour step title, pointing at the sidebar.

sidebarBody.message: Open, add and hide files, and add the npm packages your fiddle needs.
sidebarBody.description: Tour step body, pointing at the sidebar.

basicsTitle.description: Title of the last main tour step, which offers an optional walk through a fiddle's files.

basicsBody.message: Take a quick look at what each file of a fiddle does.
basicsBody.description: Body of the last main tour step, which offers an optional walk through a fiddle's files.

basicsStart.description: Button that starts the optional Electron basics part of the tour.

mainTitle.description: Electron basics tour step title about main.js.

mainBody.message: main.js starts your app and opens its windows. It runs in Node.js and can use every Electron API.
mainBody.description: Electron basics tour step body about main.js. Keep file names as they are.

htmlTitle.description: Electron basics tour step title about index.html.

htmlBody.message: index.html is the page your window shows. It loads the renderer script, like a web page does.
htmlBody.description: Electron basics tour step body about index.html. Keep file names as they are.

rendererTitle.description: Electron basics tour step title about renderer.js.

rendererBody.message: renderer.js runs inside the page. It talks to the main process through the preload script.
rendererBody.description: Electron basics tour step body about renderer.js. Keep file names as they are.
